neqsim.process.safety.selfheating
Self-heating and thermal-criticality screening for reactive porous media.
  • Classes in neqsim.process.safety.selfheating used by neqsim.process.safety.selfheating
    Class
    Description
    BasketTestPoint
    A single hot-storage ("basket") test observation: one sample size taken to its critical oven temperature.
    BasketTestRegression
    Fits Arrhenius self-heating parameters from hot-storage ("basket") test data.
    BasketTestRegressionResult
    Result of a BasketTestRegression least-squares fit of hot-storage test data.
    PorousMediaSelfHeatingAnalyzer
    Frank-Kamenetskii steady-state criticality screening for self-heating in a reactive porous body.
    PorousMediaSelfHeatingResult
    Result of a PorousMediaSelfHeatingAnalyzer Frank-Kamenetskii criticality screening.
    SelfHeatingGeometry
    Body shapes supported by the Frank-Kamenetskii steady-state criticality analysis.
    SelfHeatingInductionResult
    Result of a SelfHeatingInductionSolver transient run.
    SelfHeatingInductionSolver
    Transient one-dimensional solver for the induction time (time to ignition) of a self-heating body.
    SelfHeatingTimePoint
    A single sample of the transient temperature history produced by SelfHeatingInductionSolver.
    SelfHeatingVerdict
    Screening verdict for a self-heating criticality assessment.
    SemenovSelfHeatingAnalyzer
